backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing products, orders, user profiles, and service quote management with admin‑restricted retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining build checks, public access requirements, error handling, share‑URL validation, and deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark color tokens and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that loads the React application and sets metadata for the storefront.
frontend/public/404.html: SPA redirect fallback that captures deep links and redirects to root while preserving the intended path.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring router routes, providers, theme, error boundary, and page components including admin and quote pages.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary that displays a branded fallback UI and allows reset or page reload.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a site footer with company info, contact, navigation links, social icons, and a dynamic copyright.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays the main site header with logo, navigation links, share button, and a cart indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Wraps the page with a header, footer, and an Outlet for routed content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Shows a product’s image, name, description, price, and a link to its detail page.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Copies the current page URL to the clipboard using modern or fallback methods and shows toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with predefined questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials with ratings, names, locations, and review text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows trust badges highlighting certifications, estimates, efficiency, and warranty info.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports a constant string describing the service area.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quotes through the backend actor with query invalidation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Offers hooks to fetch all orders and update their status using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Contains hooks for CRUD and archival operations on products with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminUsers.ts: Adds admin permissions by email via the backend actor and shows success or error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the current user's role from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and loading identities via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Defines a mutation hook that sends order data to the backend and refreshes the orders query.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Provides query hooks for fetching active products and individual product details from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Creates a mutation hook to submit service quote requests, with toast notifications and query invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout enforcing authentication and admin role before rendering navigation and nested admin pages.
Admin interface for viewing, sorting, updating, and annotating service quote leads.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Admin page listing all orders with status controls and basic order details.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Admin UI for listing, creating, updating, and archiving products using product hooks and a dialog form.
Admin page for granting admin permissions to users by email with form submission and status feedback.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays cart contents with quantity controls, item removal, and navigation to checkout.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout form input, validation, order submission, and redirects to confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows order confirmation details and provides navigation back to the product listing.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays product details with quantity selection and add-to-cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Form page for submitting service quote requests with validation, submission handling, and success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Public storefront page showing hero section, trust signals, service highlights, and active products.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with add, remove, update, clear, and total calculation, persisted in storage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the project state, features, issues, and deployment-related requests.
